coverage.construction_date_basis: RSO coverage (first built on or before Oct. 1, 1978, plus replacement units)
coverage.other_conditions: Property must be in the City of Los Angeles and subject to the RSO. Replacement units under LAMC § 151.28 are also covered regardless of construction date.
coverage.summary: Rental units in the City of Los Angeles subject to the Rent Stabilization Ordinance: generally properties first built on or before October 1, 1978, plus replacement units under LAMC § 151.28.
unverifiable_exemptions: RSO luxury exemption (landlord establishes the monthly rent charged on or before May 31, 1978)

result.notes:
Changes to the coverage object:
- Removed from the summary the claim that the rule operates alongside Civ. Code § 1950.5. No document supports it.
- Set requires_unknown_facts to false. The RSO covers ordinary pre-Oct. 1, 1978 rental buildings, so it is not limited to a class of buildings that assessor data cannot identify.
- Added the RSO luxury exemption to unverifiable_exemptions.
- Noted in other_conditions that replacement units under LAMC § 151.28 are covered regardless of construction date; assessor data cannot detect these.

What was kept and why:
- D041 says "first built" and does not name a certificate-of-occupancy basis, so the cutoff basis stays year_built.
- No min_units was set, because condominiums and ADUs are listed as covered.
